# Visionary Grinders

> Specialty coffee pop-up and mobile coffee bar serving Houston, TX and nearby communities (Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress, Spring, Missouri City, Humble). Founded by Jasmine Rhodes. Serves specialty lattes, espresso drinks and cold brew, hot or iced, at private celebrations, workplace events, community gatherings and brand collaborations.

Book: [Request a coffee pop-up quote](https://visionarygrinderscoffee.com/book/)

## Facts
- Business: Visionary Grinders, a specialty coffee pop-up and mobile coffee bar
- Founder: Jasmine Rhodes
- Location: Houston, TX
- Service area: Houston, Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress, Spring, Missouri City, Humble
- Menu: specialty lattes (including honey vanilla and brown sugar), classic espresso drinks and cold brew, served hot or iced, made to order
- Event types: private celebrations, workplace events, community gatherings, brand collaborations, weddings, graduation parties
- Industries: corporate and office, real estate, healthcare, schools and universities, churches, property management, hotels and conferences, retail and grand openings, nonprofits
- Email: hello@visionarygrinderscoffee.com
- How to book: inquiry form at /book/ (date, guest count, location, event type)
- Pricing: quoted per event after inquiry; see /blog/coffee-pop-up-cost-houston/ for what affects cost
